review.notes: Gate at 9a88328 fails its build check (unused-variable warning at Suggested.lean:554; elaboration otherwise 7 sorries). Depcheck: 204 roadmaps, 1651 edges, 0 problems. Seeded sample checked: Layer 5 highest weights recomputed (Cartan N_i-1/2, top wedge, parity assignment); Layer 8 numbering (trialityPermD4, CartanMatrix.D 4 centre node, root/torus equations, block cycle) recomputed against the pinned declarations; SpinTrialityPinnedCarrierComparison ownership checked against ReductiveGroups 9B on main and open PRs (no second owner); SpinSimplyConnectedIntegrationComparison resolved to LieGroups Layers 4-5 and a statable simple-connectivity target. 145 of 150 cited pinned declarations opened at file:line; one cited declaration (TypeDSpinCarrier.unipotentRadicalDefiningIdeal_generated_eq_augmentation) does not exist at the pin. Headline statability probes elaborated: Spin4, Spin5, type-D half-spin highest-weight identification and SimplyConnectedSpace of compact Spin(n) are statable and absent. Sources: Panyushev Prop. 2.4/Ex. 2.5(1) p. 8 and Shlyakhtenko sections 2.1-2.4 verified; Fulton-Harris, Goodman-Wallach, Meinrenken, Kostant 1997 paywalled (uncertified); Lawson-Michelsohn, Adams, Chevalley, Cartan, Rieffel notes, Borcherds notes not legally readable (listed in needs-references.toml). The sources fetch command recorded manifest entries in packages/SpinRepresentations/sources.toml as the brief's command does.
